detail.description:
CRACK THE UNSOLVED CASE
Unsolved Case is the FREE (no ads, no microtransactions), standalone prequel to the popular cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series 'Cryptic Killer'.



IMPORTANT: "Unsolved Case" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game that requires each player to have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac . Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our Discord community!
